for idx, h in enumerate(___):

        best_h = h
        best_idx = ___
print(best_idx)

trials.title: Catching Bad input() with try / except!
trials.storyPrompt: Remember `input()` always returns text (`str`)! If a player types `"null"` when your code expects a number, `int(input(...))` raises a `ValueError`. Wrapping risky code in `try:` / `except ValueError:` catches the crash safely!
trials.objective: Read the Python snippet and tap the correct prediction.

choices.label: SHIELDED!
choices.explanation: Yes! `input()` returns `"null"`, `int("null")` raises `ValueError`, and the `except ValueError:` block catches it and prints `SHIELDED!`.
`int()` does not turn invalid words into 0 — it raises a `ValueError`.

choices.label: Crashes with ValueError
choices.explanation: Because `try / except ValueError:` wraps the call, Python catches the error instead of crashing!

hints.tier1_nudge: What happens when Python tries to convert `"null"` with `int(...)` inside a `try` block?
hints.tier2_pattern: Invalid `int(...)` jumps straight into the matching `except ValueError:` block.
hints.tier3_walkthrough: `int("null")` triggers `ValueError`, so the `except` branch runs and prints `SHIELDED!`.

trials.title: The Glitch Shield Won't Run! (and `pass`)
trials.storyPrompt: When you want an `except` block to safely ignore a bad value and do nothing, Python provides the `pass` keyword as a 'do nothing' placeholder! Right now Vortex's shield loop stops with a syntax error before it can skip the bad entry and print `10`.
trials.objective: Fix the broken `try / except` block so it skips invalid entries with `pass` and prints `10`.
trials.bugSummary: Python stops with a syntax error before skipping the bad entry and printing `10`.

starterCode.explorer:
raw = ["10", "null"]
total = 0
for s in raw:
    try:
        total += int(s)
    except ValueError
        pass
print(total)
starterCode.standard:

preBoss.text: Stay sharp, {heroName}! Use everything you mastered in Null's Polygon Citadel to break Null's lock!

preBoss.speaker: Pip
preBoss.text: Chirp! Ready to unleash real Python magic, {heroName}? Let's rescue Vortex!

postBoss.speaker: Lord Null
postBoss.text: IMPOSSIBLE!! You broke through Null's Polygon Citadel?! Retreating to Polygon Valley (64-Bit N64 Era!)!

postBoss.speaker: Vortex
postBoss.text: ROAR! I'm free, {heroName}! Feel the geometry of Pyria level up around you!

postBoss.speaker: Pip
postBoss.text: WOOHOO!! ERA COMPLETE! Step through the portal into Polygon Valley (64-Bit N64 Era!)!
